summary: Destructor for a 3D sound source object (a2) owned by an audio manager (this): recursively destroys sub-sources, aborts with -1 when the object is still attached to the scene graph, frees an optional buffer resource at offset 0x230, unregisters the object from the manager's 24-byte-strided registration array, removes it from the linked list, runs the destructor chain and frees the object memory.

local_names.this: audio manager holding the registration array

if ( a2[16] && a2[19] ) then recursively destroy a2[19] and null a2[19].
if ( SceneGraph(a2) ) then return -1, aborting destruction while the object is still registered in the scene graph.
if ( a2[140] ) then run the buffer-resource teardown path.
MultiFieldObjectDestructorWithCleanupCalls() tears down the buffer resource at offset 0x230.
When a2[16] is set and its +560 field is nonzero, unlink the resource with DoublyLinkedListNodeUnlink_0f10(a2[140]); otherwise use LinkedListRemove_59d0(a2[140]).
StateFlagSetterCleanup(a2[140]) then FreeWrapper_7bcf(a2[140]) release the buffer resource.
Scan the manager's registration array (base this[0x150], count this[0x14C], stride 24) and null any entry whose object pointer equals a2.
LinkedListRemove(a2) detaches the object from the linked list.
TwoFunctionCallChain(a2) runs the object destructor/cleanup chain.
return 0 on the completed destruction path.
